# FieldBinder AI

> Capture the field. Generate the report.

FieldBinder AI is a field documentation and reporting app for project managers and field professionals. You capture photos, videos, text notes, voice memos, measurements, files, to-dos, punch items, customer decisions, safety observations, change requests and RFIs by project. Server-side AI turns those captures into report drafts that you review, edit and export as branded PDFs. It is not a construction management platform; it is the project memory and the report generator.

## Who it is for

Industrial project managers, facility and maintenance leaders, engineering consultants, contractors and owner's reps.

## Report types

- Daily report
- Punch list
- RFI list
- Executive summary

## Platforms

- iPhone: https://apps.apple.com/us/app/fieldbinder-ai/id6792522520
- Android: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=ai.fieldbinder.app
- Web portal (review projects, edit reports, export PDFs): https://app.fieldbinder.ai
- Capture works offline and syncs when a connection returns.

## Pricing (USD)

- Free: 2 projects, no AI, no branded PDF.
- Basic $9.99/mo: capture + copy-text export. No AI.
- Pro $29/mo: all AI + branded PDF. 7-day free trial.
- Team: $35/seat/mo, 3-seat minimum, or $29/seat/mo billed annually. Contact us; no self-serve Team purchase.
